title: PurpleUI Foundation Spec
description: Lightweight core-shape check for specs/foundation-*.json. Deliberately permissive on extra fields (additionalProperties: true) - foundations vary widely in their extra content (tiers, darkMode, scale, packages, variants, ...) and normalizing that wasn't in scope for this pass, only the common core fields were.

docPage.description: null when no doc page exists yet - checked against the filesystem by scripts/validate-specs.ts, never a route that doesn't actually resolve to a page.
